_meta.description: Pre-registered fresh candidate pool for a frozen three-way open_microwave comparison: FastWAM baseline, no-imagination residual, and weight=0.25 imagination residual.
_meta.selection_rule: Take the first thirty candidates with exact successful expert planning/replay, preserving candidate order. Selection must not inspect any FastWAM or residual outcome.
_meta.stopping_rule: Run all three frozen variants on all thirty selected cases without retuning or outcome-based replacement.
